title: Scripture Reading Coupled With Rosary Days
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:ops weekday=* coupled_day=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(coupled_day="yes",1,0))) as matched by weekday
| eval a_day_with_both_practices_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_day_with_both_practices_pct
description: Measures the percentage of daily practice logs that end with a day with both practices by weekday.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which weekday are helping or hurting daily practice logs.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a day with both practices` on `faith:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `weekday`.
visualization: Table of weekday with percentage of daily practice logs ending with a day with both practices.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how often a day with both practices happens for each weekday so you can see where daily practice logs go smoothly or get stuck.
